description: Auto-generates a weekly accomplishment report by pulling completed work from Jira, GitHub, Confluence, Slack, and Obsidian meeting notes. Complements the weekly-action-scanner (which extracts future action items) by synthesizing what was actually accomplished. Triggers on: "weekly status", "status report", "what did I do this week", "week in review", "weekly recap", "generate status", "/weekly-status".
